label: L-12
title: CurveAMMAdapter.swap does not independently verify amountOut >= minAmountOut after router returns — delegates floor enforcement entirely to Curve Router NG
description: After router.exchange returns amountOut, no require(amountOut >= minAmountOut) check is performed. The strategy trusts the Curve Router NG's internal _min_dy enforcement exclusively. A misconfigured, buggy, or future-upgraded router could return a below-floor value without the adapter detecting it.
impact: Low in practice: the router is immutable and battle-tested. Risk only materialises under a future strategy redeployment with an incorrect router address. Defense-in-depth recommendation.
attackPath: CurveAMMAdapter.swap calls router.exchange and trusts the returned amountOut
No require(amountOut >= minAmountOut) after router returns
A future redeployment with a misconfigured or buggy router address would silently accept below-floor output
Strategy would accept a swap that delivers less underlying than the slippage floor requires
